panels.narrative: Suddenly, the visualization window collapsed. In its place, a terminal window snapped open, filling the center monitor.
The standard command prompt was gone, replaced by a flickering cursor that moved of its own accord. It began to output characters that Jed didn't recognize—blocky, ancient, and sharp.

The script didn't scroll; it etched itself onto the screen with a permanence that seemed to burn into the liquid crystal. Sarah grabbed her phone to run a translation API, but the screen was already changing.
